questions.text: How has the year been, really?

answers.body: I went back in April for the first time since I left, and the thing that undid me was not the buildings at all. It was the sound, that particular quiet the valley has at four in the afternoon before the birds start up again. I stood by the tamarind for a while feeling ridiculous about it. Nobody warned me that the dining hall would smell exactly the same. We drove up from Bangalore and got lost twice, which felt right. The new dorm block is fine but the old one had better light. I still cannot eat curd rice without thinking of Tuesday lunch. Someone had kept the noticeboard from 1998, pinned notes and all. My daughter asked why everyone was hugging and I did not have a short answer. The hill looked smaller, which everyone says and which is still true. There is a new gate and the old watchman is still there, which is the whole school in one sentence. We sat on the boulders until it was properly dark and nobody wanted to be the first to leave.
